previous_catalog_record.summary: FIXED-HEIGHT grid (h = 9, w ∈ [3, 14]) with: (a) TOP PANEL (rows 0-3) — 4 rows filled with a PATTERN (random/blob/stripes/checker/border/diagonal) using TOP-COLOR at chosen density (~0.3-0.7); (b) SEPARATOR row 4 painted with a SEP color distinct from top/bot; (c) BOTTOM PANEL (rows 5-8) — 4 rows filled with the SAME PATTERN using BOT-COLOR with chosen density. At least one cell DIFFERS in zero-occupancy across panels. Rule (XOR OF ZERO-OCCUPANCY → OUTPUT 4 × w): output is a 4 × w GRID. For each (r, c) with r ∈ [0, 3]: if EXACTLY ONE of g[r][c] and g[5+r][c] is ZERO (XOR-different occupancy), PAINT the output cell at (r, c) with COLOR 3. Else (both zero or both nonzero), 0. Net: the symmetric difference of the two panels' occupancy patterns is drawn in color 3 on a 4-row output.

sequential_dependency.intermediate: The episode-fixed intermediate is the largest XOR component and its bounding box, using a row-major bounding-box top-left tie-break. The counterfactual corrupts only that selection by choosing the smallest component.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Compute the 4 x width occupancy-XOR mask from corresponding top and bottom panel cells, then segment its four-connected components.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Paint color 3 only on the border of the selected component bounding box in a blank 4 x width output.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: The output rectangle coordinates are read from the component selected in step A; changing the mask changes the component set, selected bbox, and therefore the final painted border.
